page_title: COM 1-0 TOR | Como v Torino 13/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' The Torino players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
90+3' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Torino can stand using VAR.
90+2' It's in! Ivan Ilic (Torino) changes the scoreline.
90+2' Torino get a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Alberto Moreno makes way for Alex Valle (Como).
89' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Karol Linetty is replaced by Adrien Tameze (Torino).
88' The corner from Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) is hurriedly cleared.
87' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marcenaro and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

87' Eljif Elmas (Torino) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Torino.

87' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
85' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marcenaro had an easy-decision to make.
83' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Assane Diao and he is replaced by Alieu Fadera (Como).
83' Cesc Fabregas is forced to make a change. Sergi Roberto (Como) is unable to continue due to injury, Nico Paz comes on.
82' The game is interrupted now, Sergi Roberto (Como) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
80' Here comes a substitution. Saul Coco is given a rest as he is replaced by Adam Masina (Torino).
80' Paolo Vanoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marcus Pedersen (Torino) replacing Sebastian Walukiewicz.
80' Substitution. Gvidas Gineitis did his best and is replaced by Ivan Ilic (Torino).
79' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked.
77' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' The corner is swung in but Como can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

75' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save. Como will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
75' Como have been awarded a corner kick.

74' Assane Diao (Como) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Corner kick. Como will have an opportunity.
72' The ball is cleared after Yann Karamoh (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
71' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Gabriel Strefezza (Como) replaces Jonathan Ikone.
71' Substitution. Sergi Roberto (Como) replaces Maxence Caqueret.

69' A cross from the side finds Eljif Elmas (Torino), who unleashes a shot from the edge of the box. The ball is aimed to the left side of the goal, but the keeper makes a decent save to thwart the effort.
69' Maxence Caqueret (Como) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
68' The ball is out of play. Como will take a throw-in.
66' We are about to witness a subsitution. Yann Karamoh (Torino) for Cesare Casadei.
65' Jonathan Ikone (Como) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
64' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 59:41.
63' Che Adams (Torino) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
62' The foul by Antonio Sanabria (Torino) was seen by Matteo Marcenaro who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

60' A precise low pass is received by Lucas Da Cunha (Como), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
59' Maxence Caqueret (Como) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
58' Como will take a free kick near the side line.
56' The ball is played back to Lucas Da Cunha (Como), who controls it instantly and releases a piledriver from long range, but the shot lacks accuracy and drifts well wide of the left post.

55' What a wonderful moment! Eljif Elmas (Torino) receives a perfect pass in the middle of the pitch, lines up the ball and unloads a powerful strike towards the left post. His effort fails to surprise Jean Butez, who makes a nice save. The ball goes out for a corner. Torino can continue in their attacking effort.
54' Como take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
53' Jonathan Ikone (Como) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Como.
51' Jonathan Ikone (Como) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the right post.
50' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) plays a one-two with Jonathan Ikone, but the move breaks down.
48' Che Adams (Torino) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
47' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' A cross by Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Como take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

45' What a wonderful moment! Alberto Moreno (Como) receives a perfect pass in the middle of the pitch, lines up the ball and unloads a powerful strike towards the bottom right corner. His effort fails to surprise Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who makes a nice save. Como have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
43' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Che Adams (Torino) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The linesman signals a throw-in for Torino.
42' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
41' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.

38' 1 - 0 Mergim Vojvoda produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Anastasios Douvikas (Como) rises high to head the ball into the bottom left corner and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:0.
37' Matteo Marcenaro blows the whistle, Mergim Vojvoda (Como) is penalised for a foul.
35' A quickly taken corner by Como.

34' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort. The referee blows his whistle, Como are awarded a corner kick.
33' The ball goes out of play and Como have been awarded a corner kick.

33' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the top left corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic denies him. Como force a corner. They send men into the box.
31' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Saul Coco (Torino) for his blatant foul.
30' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
29' Jonathan Ikone (Como) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
28' Eljif Elmas (Torino) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
27' Maximo Perrone (Como) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for an infringement.
26' Como are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

25' Assane Diao (Como) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the left side of the goal, but it wasn't dangerous and Vanja Milinkovic-Savic made a comfortable save.
24' Karol Linetty (Torino) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
22' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino). Matteo Marcenaro saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
20' Jonathan Ikone (Como) plays a through ball but overhits it.
19' Maxence Caqueret (Como) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

18' Assane Diao (Como) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Como force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
18' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) plays a through ball but overhits it.
17' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
16' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Torino will take a corner kick.
15' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jean Butez intercepts the ball.
14' Assane Diao (Como) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.

12' Eljif Elmas (Torino) finds his teammate, who is lurking close to the offside line, with a nice through pass. The opponent's defence is having a really hard time dealing with these kind of situations.
10' The Torino players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
6' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
5' Alberto Moreno (Como) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
4' Assane Diao (Como) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
2' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Torino will kick the game off.
Matteo Marcenaro got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
